_meta.source: TempGuru role definitions; mirrors role x city page slugs

roles.name: Setup & Breakdown Crew
roles.description: Physical labor for event setup and teardown: tables, chairs, signage, AV equipment, decor. Pre-event and post-event shifts.

roles.name: Booth Monitors
roles.description: Stationary supervision of exhibitor booths, demo stations, or product displays. Light engagement, basic information handoff.

roles.name: Ushers
roles.description: Guest flow management, seating direction, light wayfinding at theaters, ceremonies, and large gatherings.

roles.name: Gate Staff
roles.description: Entry-point credentialing, ticket scanning, ID verification, and access control. Often paired with security at larger events.

roles.name: Registration Staff
roles.description: Tablet-based or kiosk check-in, badge printing, attendee lookups, and on-site corrections. Common at conferences and conventions.

roles.name: Hospitality Staff
roles.description: F&B service: servers, bartenders, banquet staff. TIPS certification often required for alcohol service.

roles.name: Brand Ambassadors
roles.description: On-brand product representation, sampling, demo, and consumer engagement at activations, retail, and field marketing events.

roles.name: Guest Services
roles.description: Concierge-level support: VIP check-in, problem resolution, hospitality coordination. Brand-voice critical.

roles.name: Crowd Control
roles.description: Crowd flow management, line control, queue management, and light de-escalation. Safety-trained, not licensed security.

roles.name: Assistant Leads
roles.description: Section or zone supervision under a Team Lead: shift coordination, break rotations, headcount checks, and on-the-ground problem-solving for a cluster of staff. The bridge between front-line crew and the Team Lead.

roles.name: Team Leads
roles.description: On-site crew supervision, client liaison, schedule management, and quality assurance. Accountable for crew performance.
